name: QiYi Axis Cube (Tiled - Icy Amber)
description: The QiYi Axis Cube (Tiled – Icy Amber) is a stylish take on a classic 3x3 shape mod. With its offset axis and twisted cuts, this puzzle offers a fun and challenging spatial experience, transforming into wild shapes as you scramble it. The semi-transparent icy amber tiles, laid out in a full traditional color scheme, give it a shimmering, crystal-like appearance that looks fantastic from any angle.
